descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S21 「Web 上的实时口述：HTTPS 信令和 DTLS-SRTP 媒体，医院和养老院」 Live dictation on the web: HTTPS signalling and DTLS-SRTP media, Hospital and Nursing Home

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Every network request the app makes (web, iOS and Android, in Hospital and Nursing Home) uses HTTPS. There is no plain-HTTP endpoint anywhere.（UAT OAT-02；UAT 4；TFA-92568 AC 4；TFA-92568 Eng 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress
  • U2 All traffic is encrypted in transit. This includes the live-dictation audio stream and the backend's calls to the AI and email providers (Bedrock, Vertex, OpenAI, SES).（UAT OAT-02；TFA-92568 AC 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given The deployed QA build in desktop Chrome with DevTools Network and chrome://webrtc-internals open, and a real microphone. Not on and never with store-review-test-account@roundcompanion.com. Run only on the deployment Q8 names. …

When Start live dictation once per entry point: 'QA Hosp Enc-01' Pre-Round, 'QA Resident Enc-01' Pre-Round and Encounter tabs. Then go offline for 30 s, come back and restart dictation once in each mode.

Then Each start signals over https:// (POST api.openai.com/v1/realtime/calls after the key is minted through the deployment), and webrtc-internals shows the media with dtlsState 'connected' and an SRTP cipher. A whisper recovery upload, if one happens, goes over https://. Nothing in the dictation path uses http: or ws:.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U1/U2 for the dictation class, per mode (3.3). Any dictation request on http: or ws:, or media without DTLS, = Fail, quoted with the mode and tab. WebRTC media is judged per Q1: encrypted transport accepted and recorded as non-HTTPS.

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S21 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-02.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 dev 跑；来源：dev。
